translations.b0442: Part 14  Modernizing the National Security System and Capacity and Building a Peaceful China at a Higher Level
translations.b0443: Unwaveringly implement the holistic approach to national security, accelerate the creation of a new security architecture, strengthen strategic initiative in safeguarding and shaping national security, follow the path of socialist social governance with Chinese characteristics, and ensure that society remains both vibrant and well-ordered.
translations.b0444: Chapter 51  Strengthening the National Security System and Capacity
translations.b0445: Take strategy as the guide, policy as the lever, the rule of law as the guarantee and risk prevention and control as the ultimate objective; consolidate the centralized, unified, efficient and authoritative leadership system for national security; formulate and implement the national security strategy; and improve the national security legal system, strategy system, policy system and risk prevention and control system. Strengthen coordination mechanisms for key areas and important special items of national security, and improve the effectiveness of emergency response and contingency handling. Implement the national security responsibility system, promote coordination and interaction across the whole chain and all elements, and create synergy across the system. Strengthen national security capacity building in key areas, forge practical and effective national security capabilities, give prominence to safeguarding the major security interests vital to long-term national stability, the sound and stable development of the economy and the people’s peace and contentment, put the defense of political security first, firmly safeguard the security of state power, the system and ideology, and severely crack down on infiltration, sabotage, subversion and separatist activities by hostile forces. Consolidate the foundational support for national security, strengthen the empowerment of science and technology, and strengthen national security capacity building in emerging fields. Safeguard state secrets in key areas. Improve national security mechanisms involving foreign countries, build an overseas security guarantee system, strengthen the struggle against sanctions, interference and “long-arm jurisdiction”, and deepen international law enforcement and security cooperation. Strengthen national security education and build a solid people’s line of defense.
translations.b0447: Focus on key commodities to strengthen the security of strategic materials, focus on systemically important fields to prevent and defuse major risks, focus on new industries, new forms of business and new application scenarios to improve risk prevention and control in weak links, and drive an all-round improvement in security capacity by precisely shoring up shortcomings.
translations.b0448: Section 1  Strengthening Capacity for Ensuring Food Security
translations.b0449: Adhere to the approach of self-reliance, with domestic production as the basis, production capacity as the guarantee, moderate imports as a supplement and science and technology as the support; improve the coordinated capacity to guarantee grain production, purchasing, storage, processing and marketing; and ensure the basic self-sufficiency of grain and the absolute security of staple food. Strictly implement the requirement that Party committees and governments at all levels share equal responsibility for farmland protection and food security, and strictly observe the farmland red line. Strengthen grain purchasing, marketing and reserve management, keep the scale of government grain reserves relatively stable, strengthen the regulatory function of reserves, and improve new models of grain supervision. Further implement the high-quality grain project and advance quality improvement and efficiency gains in grain circulation. Advance conservation and loss reduction across the entire post-harvest grain chain and implement the whole-grain action plan. Improve the chemical fertilizer reserve system and ensure the supply and stabilize the prices of potash, phosphate and other fertilizers. Establish stable and controllable overseas supply channels, diversify imports of agricultural products, import scarce high-quality varieties in moderation, and promote coordination between trade and production.
translations.b0450: Section 2  Strengthening Energy and Resource Supply Guarantees
translations.b0451: Adhere to relying on domestic supply, shoring up weak links, diversifying guarantees and strengthening reserves, and strengthen the development of the energy production, supply, storage and marketing system. Maintain independent guarantees for core oil and gas demand, implement the strategic action for medium- and long-term increases in oil and gas reserves and production, ensure that annual crude oil output remains stable at around 200 million tonnes and that natural gas output grows steadily, and strengthen coal-to-oil and coal-to-gas production capacity and technological reserves. Strengthen coordination between government and enterprise reserves, expand the scale of national oil reserves, establish a more flexible rotation and drawdown mechanism, enhance the regulating and guaranteeing capacity of natural gas reserves, and improve the coal reserve system. Improve the medium- and long-term contract system for energy supply guarantees, improve the emergency power dispatch mechanism and backup power configuration, and strengthen energy demand-side management. Strengthen the exploration, development and reserves of strategic mineral resources, further implement the new round of the strategic action for breakthroughs in mineral exploration, strengthen in a coordinated way reserves of products, production capacity and production sites, promote the development of bulk commodity storage and transport bases, and improve the monitoring and early warning of security risks and the level of emergency supply guarantees for strategic mineral resources. Strengthen international cooperation in energy and resource development and safeguard the security of strategic corridors.
translations.b0452: Section 3  Improving Long-Term Mechanisms for Preventing and Defusing Risks in Key Areas
translations.b0453: Strengthen source prevention and control, anticipatory judgment and early warning, and early correction; advance in a coordinated way the orderly defusing of risks in real estate, local government debt, small and medium-sized financial institutions and other areas; and strictly prevent systemic risks. Improve supervision of systemically important financial institutions and strengthen macroprudential management in key areas such as financial markets and cross-border capital flows. Establish a sound full-caliber monitoring and supervision system for local government debt and a long-term mechanism for preventing and defusing hidden debt risks, tighten fiscal and financial discipline, resolutely curb new hidden local government debt, optimize the debt structure of central and local governments, and accelerate the reform and transformation of local government financing platforms. Support financial institutions in carrying out capital replenishment in a steady and orderly manner, improve the risk disposal mechanism for small and medium-sized financial institutions, enrich the resources and instruments for risk disposal, and replenish the financial stability guarantee fund, the deposit insurance fund and other industry guarantee funds. Strengthen coordination between central and local financial supervision, improve the mechanism for protecting the rights and interests of financial consumers, and severely crack down on illegal financial activities. Strengthen financial security guarantees under opening-up conditions and improve the monitoring, early warning and response mechanism for cross-border capital flows.
translations.b0455: Deepen comprehensive governance of cyberspace security and accelerate the development of the national cybersecurity defense system. Improve foundational systems such as critical information infrastructure security protection, cybersecurity review and cloud computing service security assessment, and improve laws and regulations on internet content management and online platform governance. Severely crack down on cybercrimes and strengthen the protection of personal information. Continue to carry out the “Qinglang” (Clear and Bright) series of special actions, address online rumors, cyberbullying and other disorderly phenomena, and foster a clean and upright online environment. Support technological innovation and industrial development in cybersecurity and encourage the development of secure and reliable information products and services. Advance the development of disaster recovery and backup systems and strengthen cybersecurity protection for industrial control systems and new technologies and applications. Deeply participate in global cyberspace governance and the formulation of international rules, and actively expand international cybersecurity cooperation.
translations.b0456: Chapter 53  Improving the Level of Public Safety Governance
translations.b0457: Improve the public safety system, shift the public safety governance model toward prevention in advance, and effectively safeguard the safety of people’s lives and property.
translations.b0458: Section 1  Strengthening Food and Drug Safety Supervision
translations.b0459: Improve the whole-chain and whole-process supervision mechanism for food and drugs and improve the food and drug safety responsibility system. Strengthen food safety supervision from farm to table, strengthen source control of risks, improve the level of coordinated and smart supervision, and deepen the treatment of pesticide residues in agricultural products with prominent problems. Improve strict and efficient drug supervision, further implement the action plan for raising drug standards, and strengthen sampling and spot checks of high-risk products. Improve the quality and effectiveness of consistency evaluations of the quality and efficacy of generic drugs and strengthen the monitoring of post-marketing clinical use data. Ensure that industry supervision, territorial management and the primary responsibility of enterprises for food and drug safety are fulfilled, and intensify punishment for illegal and criminal acts. Strictly supervise the research, development and application of biotechnology and enhance the capacity to store and safely manage biological data resources.
translations.b0460: Section 2  Improving the Level of Work Safety
translations.b0461: Strictly implement the requirement that Party committees and governments share equal responsibility for work safety and the “three musts” requirement that those who oversee an industry, a business or production operations must also oversee safety, and effectively prevent and curb major and catastrophic accidents. Improve the intrinsic safety of important infrastructure, accelerate the phasing out and upgrading of high-risk processes and equipment in mines, hazardous chemicals, special equipment and other fields, and strengthen safety training for principal persons in charge of production and business units and for workers in special types of work. Improve the mechanisms for screening and rectifying work safety risks and for tracing responsibility, urge enterprises to improve their work safety management systems, and improve the level of work safety risk prevention and emergency response to accidents and disasters. Improve the quality and effectiveness of work safety law enforcement, establish lists of key items for law enforcement inspections in each industry, and carry out central work safety assessments and inspections in a solid manner.
translations.b0462: Section 3  Improving the Emergency Management System
translations.b0463: Put the people and life first, improve in an integrated way the capacity for disaster reduction and prevention, disaster resistance and fortification, and disaster relief and support, and effectively reduce losses from all types of disasters and accidents. Strengthen disaster monitoring, forecasting and early warning, and improve all-weather real-time monitoring and early warning capacity. Appropriately raise the fortification standards for key infrastructure in important cities and disaster-prone areas, and advance the development of urban public infrastructure for both normal and emergency use. Deepen emergency management reform and improve the emergency command mechanism under the “big security, big emergency response” framework. Improve the capacity for disaster prevention, reduction and relief and for handling major public emergencies, build up the national comprehensive fire and rescue force, optimize the structure and layout of professional rescue teams, and improve rescue capacity under extreme conditions. Implement actions to strengthen grassroots emergency response capacity, improve integrated grassroots emergency response and firefighting rescue, and enhance the capacity of the whole of society to prevent disasters and avoid risks. Strengthen the development and management of the emergency plan system and improve the diversified emergency supplies reserve and rapid allocation and delivery mechanism. Improve the catastrophe risk protection system and risk-sharing mechanism.
translations.b0464: Chapter 54  Improving the Social Governance System
translations.b0465: Uphold systematic, law-based, comprehensive and source-based governance, improve the social governance system based on collaboration, participation and common interests, improve the systems and mechanisms for social work and the policy, law and regulation system for social governance, and advance the modernization of social governance.
translations.b0466: Section 1  Consolidating the Foundations of Grassroots Social Governance
translations.b0467: Uphold and develop the “Fengqiao Experience” of the new era and improve the urban and rural grassroots governance system that combines self-governance, the rule of law and the rule of virtue under the leadership of Party organizations. Strengthen Party building-led grassroots governance and the building of grassroots political power, comprehensively implement the list of matters for which townships (subdistricts) perform their duties, improve the access system for work items in villages (communities), implement the practice of “going down to the grassroots in four respects”, and improve practices such as “the street and township blow the whistle and departments report for duty”. Shift the focus of social governance and services down to the grassroots, strengthen the allocation of grassroots service and management personnel, improve service facilities and funding guarantee mechanisms, improve the urban and rural community governance system, and improve the grassroots governance platform featuring grid-based management, refined services and information technology support. Improve the working mechanisms for uniting and serving the people and consolidate the popular foundation of social governance. Give play to the principal role of the people and guide all parties to participate in social governance in an orderly manner. Strengthen the ranks of social workers and improve the level of professional services. Advance coordinated online and offline governance. Strengthen the functions of public service platforms such as citizen hotlines and ensure that the people’s calls always receive a response.
translations.b0468: Section 2  Improving Governance Effectiveness in Emerging Fields
translations.b0469: Strengthen Party building in new economic organizations, new social organizations and among new groups of people in employment, further expand the coverage of Party organizations and Party work, and strengthen and improve political guidance and service management for all types of social groups. Improve the quality of Party building in non-public enterprises, strengthen classified guidance for Party building in mixed-ownership enterprises, and give prominence to Party building in business districts, office buildings and industrial parks. Strengthen the cultivation and management of social organizations and promote the reform and development of industry associations and chambers of commerce. Strengthen the management of volunteer service organizations, improve incentive and commendation mechanisms, and develop volunteer services. Strengthen the service, management and care of new groups of people in employment.
translations.b0470: Section 3  Effectively Safeguarding Social Safety and Stability
translations.b0471: Improve the mechanisms for correctly handling contradictions among the people under new circumstances, keep open and regulate channels for the public to express their demands and for coordinating interests and safeguarding rights and interests, and further advance the resolution of conflicts and disputes at the source, through multiple means and in an orderly manner. Advance the law-based handling of public complaints and petitions, continue to have leading officials receive and visit petitioners, and deepen the resolution of prominent contradictions in petitioning. Improve the social psychological service system and crisis intervention mechanisms. Further develop the overall crime prevention and control system and capacity for public order, implement responsibilities for maintaining social stability, develop and strengthen mass prevention and mass governance forces, improve the long-term mechanism for cracking down on gang crime and evil forces, and intensify the prevention and crackdown on telecom and online fraud, drug-related crime and other crimes. Advance the standardized development of comprehensive social order management centers. Comprehensively and accurately implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity, punish illegal and criminal acts in accordance with the law, and improve the quality and effectiveness of penalty enforcement. Advance the development of digital platforms for political and legal work.
